frame_semantics.motor_zero: User-specified mechanical/electrical zero; do not use as standing reward reference
frame_semantics.mjcf_ref: MJCF kinematic coordinate reference, separately recorded per joint
frame_semantics.standing_reference: HOME keyframe; all actor relative joint positions and head delta commands reference HOME

height_binding_requirements: env.goal_height_m in every phase must come from this contract
init qpos must come from HOME; do not overwrite its geometric root z with the settled reward target
height goal ratio = goal_height_m / HOME root z
settle outcome, completion tests, head eligibility and evaluators consume the same goal_height_m
recovery-style thresholds at 0.18/0.235 m require new-model posture validation, not blanket replacement
recalibrate and invalidate derived thresholds if HOME, sole geometry, gains or motor parameters change
head_soft_motion_behavior: pause target ramp; retain command and bias history
head_hard_exit: measured tilt>=30deg, invalid permission or persistent leg instability
